# Generated command and marker reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs_reference.py; do not edit by hand. -->

## Commands

| Recipe | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Default recipe. |
| `docs-generate` | Regenerate command and marker documentation from executable sources. |
| `docs-check` | Check generated references, stale paths, and text encoding. |
| `setup` | Create or update the locked development environment. |
| `test` | Run the complete trusted selection and write version-5 evidence. |
| `test-fast` | Run a partial selection that excludes slow and quarantined tests. |
| `test-marker expression` | Run a partial marker expression (usage: just test-marker "unit and regression"). |
| `test-quarantined` | Run quarantined tests diagnostically; never use this as trusted evidence. |
| `lint` | Check source, tests, and operational scripts. |
| `format` | Format source, tests, and operational scripts. |
| `format-check` | Verify formatting without changing files. |
| `check` | Run the ordinary local hard gate. |
| `health` | Assess flakes only across comparable complete trusted runs. |
| `compatibility` | Export this environment's compatibility cell. |
| `build` | Build the source distribution and wheel. |
| `test-wheel` | Build, install, and execute the wheel outside the source tree. |
| `performance` | Measure the packaged command against the project-owned specification. |
| `release-check evidence=".cache/compatibility"` | Aggregate all release obligations; compatibility evidence must cover the matrix. |

## Pytest markers

| Marker | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `unit` | Small local structural scope. |
| `component` | Coherent subsystem structural scope. |
| `integration` | Real boundary semantics structural scope. |
| `system` | Assembled product structural scope. |
| `acceptance` | Stakeholder-relevant purpose. |
| `regression` | Protects established behavior or a learned failure mode. |
| `contract` | Producer-consumer or compatibility purpose. |
| `smoke` | Small critical-capability selection. |
| `compatibility` | Supported environment or artifact purpose. |
| `property_based` | Generated invariant technique. |
| `fuzz` | Generated or mutated adversarial-input technique. |
| `filesystem` | Uses real filesystem semantics. |
| `process` | Crosses a process boundary. |
| `slow` | Excluded from the fast selection. |
| `quarantined` | Excluded from trusted evidence under an owned, expiring record. |
| `requirement(id)` | Links evidence to a declared responsibility. |
